blocks.title: Your AGI element starts here
blocks.description: This is not just a site template. It quickly grows into what you need: an agent that solves your tasks, an application, or automation of your business processes — you decide. All you bring is the idea; Fractera AGI does the rest.

blocks.text: It builds the application with you: the Claude Code agent of this element writes the code from your description.
It takes what is ready from the built-in Store: more than 2,000 reliable, continuously updated skills, plugins and MCP servers.
It finds ready solutions in the AGI-web3 infrastructure, so you can buy them and plug them in.
You describe your idea — the agent works through the possible ways, agrees them with you, and you get a reliable result fast.
A built-in database, sign-in with user roles and dozens of other solutions. All of their code is open right inside your application: fix it, improve it or remove it — it is up to you.
